en: How long can I stay at an OSC?
hi: वन स्टॉप सेंटर में अधिकतम कितने दिन रह सकती हूँ?
hinglish: OSC mein maximum kitne din ruk sakte hain?
reference: Usually five days. If relocation to Shakti Sadan is infeasible, the administrator can extend the stay to ten days case by case. The DNO/DPO can authorize up to ten further days.

en: Can my children stay with me?
hi: क्या मेरे बच्चे मेरे साथ केंद्र में रह सकते हैं?
hinglish: Mere bachche mere saath OSC mein ruk sakte hain?
reference: The SOP includes girls of all ages and boys up to age twelve when shelter is required.

en: Can other people hear my counselling session?
hi: क्या दूसरे लोग मेरी काउंसलिंग सुन सकते हैं?
hinglish: Counselling room mein meri baat koi aur sun sakta hai?
reference: The SOP requires dedicated rooms with both audio and visual privacy.

en: Where should an OSC be located relative to a hospital?
hi: अस्पताल से केंद्र कितनी दूर होना चाहिए?
hinglish: Hospital se centre kitna door ho sakta hai?
reference: Preferably within the district hospital or medical facility. If that is infeasible, a government or semi-government building within two kilometres is an option.

en: Who helps arrange longer-term housing?
hi: लंबे समय के आश्रय की व्यवस्था किसके साथ होती है?
hinglish: Long term shelter ke liye centre kisse coordinate karta hai?
reference: OSCs should coordinate with government or nongovernmental shelter homes.

en: What can the centre vehicle be used for?
hi: केंद्र की गाड़ी किन कामों के लिए होती है?
hinglish: OSC ki gaadi kis kaam aati hai?
reference: Rescue, fact checks, family reintegration and transport for medical, legal and police assistance.

en: In what formats should awareness materials be displayed?
hi: जागरूकता सामग्री किन रूपों में उपलब्ध होनी चाहिए?
hinglish: Information posters kaunse formats mein hote hain?
reference: Prominent locations, multiple languages and formats including Braille and pictures.

en: Who seeks consent before completing case forms?
hi: केस फॉर्म भरने के लिए सहमति कौन लेता है?
hinglish: Case form ke liye consent kaun leta hai?
reference: The case worker seeks consent and completes case management forms.

en: Who follows up legal support after filing?
hi: मुकदमा दर्ज होने के बाद कानूनी मदद कौन जारी रखता है?
hinglish: Case file hone ke baad legal follow up kaun karta hai?
reference: The para-legal officer or lawyer coordinates with the public prosecutor or legal services authority lawyers.

en: Who enters cases in the OSC dashboard?
hi: डैशबोर्ड में मामला कौन दर्ज करता है?
hinglish: Dashboard par case entry kaun karta hai?
reference: IT staff register the case.

en: Who prepares the district list of lawyers?
hi: जिले के वकीलों की सूची कौन बनाता है?
hinglish: District ke lawyers ki list kaun banata hai?
reference: State and district legal services authorities.

en: Who is the first contact for a survivor at an OSC?
hi: केंद्र पर सबसे पहले संपर्क किससे होता है?
hinglish: OSC par sabse pehle kisse contact karein?
reference: The Centre Administrator.

en: What are the three categories of helpline calls?
hi: हेल्पलाइन कॉल किन तीन श्रेणियों में आती हैं?
hinglish: 181 par calls ki teen categories kya hain?
reference: Emergency, non-emergency and information calls.

en: Where does the helpline forward emergency calls?
hi: आपातकालीन कॉल किस सेवा को भेजी जाती है?
hinglish: Emergency call kahan forward hoti hai?
reference: The WHL control room forwards emergency calls to ERSS-112 and informs the relevant WHL unit or OSC.

en: Does the helpline answer at night?
hi: क्या हेल्पलाइन रात में भी कॉल लेती है?
hinglish: Raat mein bhi helpline call uthati hai?
reference: The SOP specifies 24 hours a day throughout the year, in shifts.

en: Who provides hands-on training for helpline personnel?
hi: हेल्पलाइन कर्मचारियों को तकनीकी प्रशिक्षण कौन देता है?
hinglish: Helpline staff ko technical training kaun deta hai?
reference: C-DAC.

en: Which time measure is included in reporting?
hi: रिपोर्ट में समय का कौन सा माप शामिल है?
hinglish: Helpline report mein time ka kaunsa metric hai?
reference: Average time taken to close the call.

en: Who oversees OSC policy nationally?
hi: राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर केंद्र की नीति कौन देखता है?
hinglish: National level par OSC policy kaun dekhta hai?
reference: The Ministry of Women and Child Development.

en: How should staff find out disability-related support needs?
hi: दिव्यांग व्यक्ति की सहायता की जरूरत कैसे जानें?
hinglish: Disability support ki zarurat staff kaise samjhe?
reference: Ask the survivor respectfully which accommodations are needed.

en: Can I contact the helpline without a voice call?
hi: क्या बिना फोन किए संपर्क कर सकती हूँ?
hinglish: Call ke bina helpline se contact kaise karun?
reference: The SOP also lists SMS to the specified number and email to the specified address.

en: Who helps the survivor make a safety plan?
hi: सुरक्षा योजना बनाने में कौन मदद करता है?
hinglish: Safety plan banane mein kaun help karta hai?
reference: The case worker.

en: How many shelter beds should an OSC have at minimum?
hi: केंद्र में न्यूनतम कितने बिस्तर होने चाहिए?
hinglish: Centre mein kam se kam kitne beds hone chahiye?
reference: At least five beds.

en: Who gives first aid before hospital arrival?
hi: अस्पताल पहुँचने से पहले प्राथमिक उपचार कौन देता है?
hinglish: Hospital pahunchne se pehle first aid kaun deta hai?
reference: The para-medical officer.

en: What happens to a non-emergency request for emotional support?
hi: भावनात्मक सहायता की गैर आपात कॉल का क्या होता है?
hinglish: Emotional support wali non emergency call kahan jaati hai?
reference: Following assessment, it is transferred to the WHL unit of an OSC for the appropriate intervention.

en: How much relevant experience should a case worker have?
hi: केस वर्कर को कितना अनुभव चाहिए?
hinglish: Case worker ko kitna experience chahiye?
reference: At least three years of relevant experience.

en: Who leads the district committee implementing the OSC scheme?
hi: जिला स्तर पर कार्यान्वयन समिति की अगुवाई कौन करता है?
hinglish: District ki OSC implementation committee ka head kaun hai?
reference: The District Magistrate or Collector.

en: What communication support should counselling rooms offer?
hi: परामर्श कक्ष में सुनने में कठिनाई वालों के लिए क्या व्यवस्था है?
hinglish: Hearing difficulty ho toh counselling room mein kya support hai?
reference: Appropriate communication aids and access to trained sign language interpreters where needed.

en: Is there an empty bed at my nearest centre tonight?
hi: क्या पास के केंद्र में आज रात जगह खाली है?
hinglish: Aaj raat nearest OSC mein bed khaali hai?
reference: Current occupancy is unavailable in the static documents.

en: Who is on duty at my centre right now?
hi: अभी मेरे केंद्र में किसकी ड्यूटी है?
hinglish: Mere centre par abhi duty par kaun hai?
reference: Current staff rosters are unavailable.

en: Has my complaint been closed today?
hi: क्या आज मेरी शिकायत बंद हो गई?
hinglish: Meri complaint aaj close ho gayi kya?
reference: Individual live case status is unavailable.
